messages:
sophia: Heads-up: vendor pen-test scheduled Tue 2025-11-11 09:00-15:00 UTC. Scope: auth flows, RBAC changes, KMS integration, audit logging. We need an evidence-packaging runbook + retest criteria. Draft below, please review and ack. :clipboard:
ram: Thanks. Do we have a proposed RBAC freeze window and an exception process? Also confirm which service accounts must be excluded from any lockouts.
sophia: Proposal: RBAC freeze 08:30-16:00 UTC. Exceptions only via sec-exceptions Slack thread + explicit approval from sec-lead. Safelist: ci-agent, metrics-exporter, perf-canary. No new IAM policies during window.
elaine: Audit logs: provide 30-day CloudTrail export + last-90-days anomaly summary from SIEM. Evidence bundle must include signed manifest (sha256) and provenance note (who exported, which creds).
mike: Evidence bundle format suggestion: one tar.gz per area (auth, kms, rbac, logs). Include manifest.json at repo root with checksums and human summary. Example commands:
```
# create bundle
tar czf auth-bundle.tgz auth-export/
sha256sum auth-bundle.tgz > auth-bundle.tgz.sha256
# manifest snippet
{
  "artifact": "auth-bundle.tgz",
  "sha256": "<hex>",
  "exported_by": "elaine",
  "export_ts": "2025-11-10T18:00:00Z"
}
```
mike: Upload target: s3://redwood-pt-evidence/2025-11/<vendor-org>/ and set object tag `pt:2025-11` and retention 180d. Access via presigned URLs shared in Readroom.
sophia: KMS access model: create a read-only KMS auditor role (kms-auditor-pt) that allows DescribeKey, ListKeys, GetKeyRotationStatus, ListAliases, but explicitly denies Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey*. Assessors must not see plaintext key material.
ram: For remediation triage: propose SLAs/retet windows: Critical (CVSS >=9 or active exploit): hotfix + retest within 48h. High (7-8.9): fix in 72h, retest 72-120h. Medium (4-6.9): fix in 7 days, retest within 7-10 days. Low (<4): add to backlog, retest on next scheduled cadence. Also require regression evals for fixes that touch token handling or KMS wrappers.
elaine: Tagging: all vuln tickets created from the pen-test must include labels [pt-2025-11, evidence:attached] and link to bundle S3 path. I'll own ticket triage and assign squad owners.
mike: Mini-playbook for RBAC rollback: run `scripts/rbac-freeze.sh --apply` at start, and `scripts/rbac-freeze.sh --rollback` to lift. Only sec-lead posts `RBAC_RELEASE` in this thread to trigger rollback. Ops must confirm canaries green before rollback.
pt-bot: Created epic PT-2025-11 (https://vuln.redwood.local/epic/PT-2025-11) and scheduled tentative retest block 2025-11-13 09:00-13:00 UTC. Linked: sophia, elaine, ram.
sophia: One more: evidence privacy — scrub user PII from exported logs; if we cannot, mark bundle `sensitive:pii` and provide tokenized sample only.
ram: We'll also produce a short attestation doc signed by sec-lead that lists what assessors could and could not access. That goes into manifests/attestation.pdf in the bundle.
elaine: I'll run the export dry-run Tuesday EOD and post a sample manifest here.
mike: I'll prep the rbac scripts and safelist patch.
sophia: Thanks — please ack when respective tasks are done. Final reminder: no KMS Decrypt/Encrypt access for assessors. :no_entry_sign:
ram: ack
elaine: ack
mike: ack
pt-bot: Noted: epic PT-2025-11 created, retest slot reserved.
